name: Adaro Chief
body:
Adaro Chief
CR 10

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.

XP 9,600
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic)
Init +4; Senses Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+3 Dex, +9 natural)
hp 112 (13d10+52)
Fort +7 Ref +12 Will +10

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee spear +13/+8/+3 (1d8+9/x3), bite +8 (1d6+6)
Ranged spear +8 (1d8+6/x3)
Special Attacks rain frenzy

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 16
Base Atk +13; CMB +19; CMD 33
Feats Dazzling Display, Deadly Aim, Intimidating Prowess, Power Attack, Shatter Defenses, Toughness, Weapon Focus (spear)
Skills Intimidate +25, Perception +18, Stealth +20, Swim +30
Languages Aquan, Common; speak with sharks
SQ amphibious, poison use

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Expert Command (Ex)

As a standard action, an adaro chief can grant all adaros and sharks within 60 feet that can hear their commands +3 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. This is a mind-affecting effect.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm oceans
Organization solitary, hunting party (2-6), or tribe (7-12)
Treasure standard (3 spears, other treasure)

This hybrid of human and shark holds its spear menacingly, thick, glistening saliva dripping from its razor-sharp teeth.
